name: flashcards-api
description: Cloudflare Worker API for the Flashcards app, backed by MongoDB Atlas and Auth0

scripts.mongo:start: docker run -d --name flashcards-mongo -p 27017:27017 mongo:7 --replSet rs0 --bind_ip_all && sleep 4 && docker exec flashcards-mongo mongosh --quiet --eval "rs.initiate({_id:'rs0', members:[{_id:0, host:'localhost:27017'}]})"
